```{r setup-98-tables-and-figures, include=FALSE}
# Knitting this section on its own? Load what ../land-tenure.Rmd normally
# provides. A no-op under the parent, 303 or 304, which already have it.
if (!exists("fmt_num")) {
  .s <- c("_setup.R", "sections/_setup.R", "narrative/sections/_setup.R")
  .s <- .s[file.exists(.s)]
  if (!length(.s)) stop("cannot find sections/_setup.R from ", getwd(), call. = FALSE)
  source(.s[1])
}
```

# Tables and Figures

```{=html}
<!-- Layout mirrors studies/resource_extraction/narrative/sections/98_tables_and_figures.Rmd.
     Tables are built by scripts/exhibit_helpers_tables.R from data/descriptive_exhibits.rds
     (written by scripts/100_exhibit_descriptive_stats.R); figures by
     scripts/101_exhibit_figures.R into output/figures/. See scripts/README.md.
     Exhibit titles are markdown headings (not flextable captions) so they appear in the Word navigation pane.
     Landscape exhibits are grouped into ONE section: emitting sec_landscape() then sec_portrait() back to back
     creates an empty portrait section, which Word renders as a blank page.
     A section's properties apply to the content BEFORE it: sec_portrait() closes a portrait run,
     sec_landscape() closes a landscape run. -->
```
